caption: today's sky on new year's eve: the moon in libra, the sun and mercury both trine mars. the moon enters scorpio after midnight.

slides.headline: the *moon* is in libra for the midnight kiss. ask nicely
a waning *moon* in libra: charm, balance, manners
slides.body: one day past last quarter. reads as a night for kindness and fair trades. the moon slips into scorpio after midnight, so things get deeper at 12:01.

slides.headline: the *sun* and mercury both trine mars
slides.body: capricorn sun and mercury, mars in virgo: drive and words agree. good for saying what you want next year, and meaning it.

slides.headline: say it before *midnight*. there is always an 11:11
slides.body: happy new year from the sky desk.
